text:
marie: CI smoke failing on shard-9 for hosted-e2e, seeing intermittent 502s when tests do streaming -> tool-call after auth handshake. started ~10:12am PT. stack shows `upstream prematurely closed connection` in proxy logs. anyone else?

alex: saw a couple flakes earlier, thought it was infra blip. can you paste the failing test command + minimal logs?

marie: sure, repro command in job: `pytest tests/integration/test_tool_streaming.py::test_stream_tool_call --host hosted-api`
logs: ```2024-05-01T17:12:30Z proxy: recv error: EOF during request body
2024-05-01T17:12:30Z hosted-api: 502 while proxying to runtime shard-9, reason: connection reset by peer```

sam: hmm looks like connection drop between runtime and the hosted frontend. Could be KV cache eviction timing or sudden worker recycle. Any recent deploys to runtime?

deploy-bot: deploy:runtime v1.34.2 -> v1.34.3 promoted 2024-05-01T16:58:12Z by @ops (canary first, 20m) :wave:

marie: that lines up. failing tests started after the promote window. alex, can you check pod restarts on shard-9?

alex: pod restarts low, but I see one OOMKill on node-17 around 16:59. Not sure it's related. Also noticed some auth handshake retries from tests: `client hello -> server hello -> application data` then immediate connection close.

tanya: could be TLS session resume regression we rolled in runtime lib (session cache tweak). If resume fails early the proxy might close stream mid-request. I'll roll back the tweak on canary and re-run smoke.

josh: quick triage — if rollback not immediate, try forcing tests to use short-lived sessions to avoid resume path: set env TEST_TLS_SESSION=off in CI job and requeue. That should tell us if resume is culprit.

marie: requeued with TEST_TLS_SESSION=off. kicking shard-9 rerun now.

sam: also add a tiny retry wrapper for the tool-call step in the test harness (2x with 200ms backoff) so CI flake doesn't block landing. Keep it behind a flag.

marie: rerun green on first attempt with TEST_TLS_SESSION=off. leaving the job running to collect more logs. thanks all. :thumbsup:

tanya: rolling back session-cache tweak from canary -> watching metrics. will follow up here once rollback finishes.

alex: capturing profiles and tcpdump from node-17 for the window, uploading to `s3://redwood-ci/traces/1718888888/`

marie: logging note: filing quick postmortem in #incidents if rollback confirms root cause. for now marking this thread as triage-done until we have rollback signal.

deploy-bot: rollback:runtime v1.34.3 -> v1.34.2 initiated 2024-05-01T17:15:02Z by @tanya (canary -> full)

marie: thanks team. follow-ups: (1) add TLS-session toggle to smoke job, (2) add lightweight retry to tool-call harness, (3) postmortem if rollback confirms.

sam: noted, I'll open the PR for the retry wrapper and include a short test.

tanya: rollback finished, canary looked stable; I'll let it roll to full and monitor for 10m then update incidents.

marie: great — closing for now. keep pings here if it reappears. :100:
